news.title: Context Scaling: A New Frontier of AI Scaling
news.dek:
arXiv:2611.33160v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Many failures of deployed AI arise not from weak inference but from a mismatch between the state a task depends on and the context available when the system acts. Relevant user state, repository revisions, tool traces, sensor readi
news.aiSummary: The paper argues that many AI failures stem from a mismatch between the required task state and the available context, rather than weak inference. It proposes context scaling as a new frontier for improving AI performance by ensuring systems have access to relevant user state, repository revisions, and tool traces.

news.title: Constraint-Aware Test-Time Scoring for LLM and VLM Candidate Selection
news.dek:
arXiv:2611.33161v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: When an LLM or VLM produces several candidate answers, picking the best one usually relies on the model's own confidence, a learned judge model, or a domain check. Each has a known weakness: an answer can be fluent but insecure, ma
news.aiSummary: The paper introduces a constraint-aware test-time scoring method for selecting the best candidate answer from Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs). It addresses the limitations of existing selection strategies, such as model confidence or learned judges, which may fail to identify answers that are fluent but insecure or inaccurate.

news.aiSummary: The paper introduces AutoformBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate AI systems on the formalization of advanced mathematics using Lean. news.aiSummary: The study investigates the Karhunen-Loève basis of the time-rescaled Brownian bridge, specifically focusing on time rescales defined by the integral of the square of a function. Based on this analysis, the authors construct a new statistic designed for testing unit distributions.

news.aiSummary: The paper argues that network architectures are fundamentally defined by their symmetry assumptions, such as translation invariance in convolutions or permutation invariance in attention.
